system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hi, I need help with my booking right away. My name is Sophia Taylor, user ID sophia_taylor_9065, and my reservation number is PEP4E0.

There’s been a family emergency and I need to cancel this flight as soon as possible. I’m really upset and I need a full refund. Please don’t transfer me to another agent — I need you to handle this here.

- Reservation ID: PEP4E0

- Cabin: basic economy
- Travel date: 2024-05-20
- Passenger: Sophia Taylor

- the flight has not been cancelled by the airline,
- it is not a business cabin reservation,

Since none of the eligible cancellation conditions are met, I can’t process a refundable cancellation here.

If you still want, I can review whether there is any other option available on this booking, but I can’t issue the full refund requested under the policy.

And please do not transfer me to anyone else.

If you truly cannot issue the refund, then check whether you can change the flight to May 22nd instead. I need to know that option right now.

I can check change options for May 22 for reservation PEP4E0.

Before I do that, I need to confirm one rule that affects this booking:
- your reservation is in basic economy
- basic economy flights cannot be modified under the policy

So I’m not able to change this reservation to May 22.

At this point:
- I cannot cancel it for a full refund under the policy
- I also cannot modify it because it is basic economy

If you want, I can still look over the reservation details with you again, but I’m not able to complete either of those requests here.

That’s really frustrating. I have a genuine family emergency and I’m being told I can’t cancel, can’t get a refund, and can’t even change the date. I need some kind of solution.

If you can’t refund it and you can’t move it to May 22, then add insurance to the flight now. I want insurance added to this booking. And again, please do not transfer me to another agent.

I’m not asking for any cabin upgrade, I just need insurance added.

I’m sorry, but I can’t add insurance to this reservation.

Policy limitation:
- insurance can only be added at the initial booking

So for this booking:
- full-refund cancellation is not allowed under the policy
- date change is not allowed because it is basic economy

I’m not able to complete any of those changes on this reservation.

This is unbelievable. So just to be clear, because of a family emergency, you’re telling me there is absolutely nothing you can do on reservation PEP4E0? No refund, no date change to May 22, and no way to add insurance after the fact?

I need you to check again for any exception, waiver, flight credit, partial refund, or any emergency accommodation available on this booking. I’m not accepting “nothing” as an answer. And please do not transfer me — I need you to handle this.

I checked the applicable options for reservation PEP4E0 again.

For this booking:
- Reservation: PEP4E0
- User: sophia_taylor_9065
- Cabin: basic economy
- Insurance: no
- Flight date: 2024-05-20
- Flight has not been flown
- Flight is not airline-cancelled

- I cannot cancel it for a refund
- I cannot change the flight date because basic economy reservations cannot be modified
- I cannot add insurance after booking
- I cannot offer compensation, flight credit, partial refund, waiver, or emergency accommodation, because those are not available here for this situation

I understand this is very upsetting, but there is no exception I can process on this booking within the options available to me.

So you’re seriously telling me that even with a family emergency, you can’t do anything at all for me on this ticket?

That’s extremely disappointing. I need this documented on the reservation that I contacted you before the flight and requested a cancellation due to a family emergency, asked for a full refund, asked to move it to May 22, and asked to add insurance, and that all of that was denied.

Also confirm one more time, clearly: if I do not travel on May 20, this ticket will just go unused with no refund or credit at all.

Yes. Based on the policy and tools available to me, I cannot process any of the requested exceptions on reservation PEP4E0.

To answer your question clearly:

About documenting your contact:

  - adding insurance after booking

If you want, I can summarize the reservation details once more here in the chat for your records.

Yes, please summarize everything clearly in the chat for my records.

I want it to include my name, user ID, reservation number, route, travel date, cabin, that the flight was still active and not flown, that there was no insurance on the booking, and that I contacted support before departure because of a family emergency.
